source.rule: For one PLID, at most one PrelifeData.QTY may be blank, explicit QTY sum must not exceed deployed/installed quantity, and sub-prelife structure must match the physical materiel path including intermediate positions.

two-blank-qty.delta: Change AGE60 QTY1 to blank while AGE120 QTY is already blank; four deployed systems otherwise unchanged.
two-blank-qty.pre_native_expected: Converter or calculation rejects two blank QTY rows for PL-SYS; exact native error codes must be observed.

overallocated-qty.delta: Change final AGE120 QTY2 to3, making PL-SYS QTY sum5 above QTYPS4; all else unchanged.
overallocated-qty.pre_native_expected: Converter or calculation rejects QTY sum above deployed count; exact native error codes must be observed.

missing-middle.delta: Omit PL-POS Prelife and PrelifeData node, connect PL-LRU directly to PL-SYS, while physical system→POS-A→LRU path is unchanged.
missing-middle.pre_native_expected: Converter or calculation rejects missing intermediate prelife path; if installed CLI instead accepts it, preserve counterexample and limit any claim to this structure.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Use serial guarded session-0 SSH native CLI probes with source/raw closure, GUI PID13340 preservation and Prelife Log option restoration. A rejected arm is accepted only when observed native diagnostics identify the specific invalid boundary and no successful SXO/valid simulation is silently treated as rejected.

Import/export row preservation is checked if native export succeeds; conversion error and note/warning codes are captured exactly. A branch that runs successfully despite manual invalidity is a bounded manual-versus-installed-CLI counterexample, not silently called a rejection.
Separate reviewer independently replays frozen source and raw diagnostics without importing author validation code.
limits: These are three single-row or single-intermediate-node negative probes from separate accepted parents; no general validation coverage or arbitrary malformed-input behavior is implied.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
